newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ceramco expects to return to profit in 98.
newsitem.headline: Ceramco expects to return to profit in 98.

text.p: Ceramco Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it expects to break even for the 1996/97 year but to return to profitability in the 1998 financial year.

It said after reporting a half year loss of NZ$1.64 million that the short term outlook for its apparel division was uncertain given the depressed level of retail activity in both the New Zealand and Australian markets.

For the remainder of this financial year, the directors will be focused on restructuring Bendon Hickory, securing distribution outlets for Microsilica, as well as realising surplus assets to reduce interest bearing debt, it said.
"Following these steps the directors believe that the Ceramco Group will return to profitability in the 1998 financial year," the company said.

Note - Ceramco Corporation Ltd is an apparel and ceramics company. Non-recurring items related to the rationalisation of the Australian Apparel Divisions sales force and restructuring at corporate head office.
